sections.name: Fire
sections.card:
Summary: Fires damage furniture and kill a Sim who catches fire and is not put out before the "I'm on Fire!" moodlet expires.
Weak points: A smoke alarm brings firefighters on its own, a fire sprinkler panel puts the fire out, and a teen or older Sim can be sent to extinguish it, though a panicking Sim may ignore the order.
Tips: Cooking accidents are the most common cause, such as a low-skill cook on a cheap stove, and decorations or objects too close to a stove, lit fireplace or campfire can start one. Nothing can be built, bought or saved while one burns.

sections.name: Cowplant
sections.card:
Summary: A plant grown from a rare berry that lures Sims with a slice of cake when hungry and kills a Sim who grabs the cake while still Drained from being eaten once.
Weak points: Feed it meat while its tongue and cake are showing; a Sim it eats the first time is spat out with a two-day Drained moodlet, so only a second grab then is deadly.
Tips: An unfed Cowplant dies 12 in-game hours after its cake shows, but the count pauses while your Sim is away from the lot, and after patch 174 a dead one can be revived for §100. Milking one that has devoured a Sim gives Essence of Life, which adds days to a Sim's life.

sections.name: Burglar
sections.card:
Summary: Robin Banks (or Fia Acosta with Royalty & Legacy) sneaks onto a residential lot to steal objects, even when a Sim is awake, with a violin-like sting on arrival.
Weak points: A Sim can fight the burglar (a win keeps them away for a few days), call the police or talk it out, and a burglar alarm by the front door scares one off and calls the police; an upgraded alarm also zaps them.
Tips: Cats, dogs, Agnes Crumplebottom and Bonehilda fight burglars on their own, but locked doors are no defence because locks can be ignored during a burglary.

sections.name: Drowning
sections.card:
Summary: A Sim who cannot get out of the water keeps swimming until the energy or hunger need runs out, and then drowns.
Weak points: Sims usually leave the water on their own, and in The Sims 4 they can climb out of a pool without a ladder, so a drowning needs the pool blocked in by walls or objects.
Tips: In Get Famous a Sim who falls into the Luminary's Exotic Water Garden while the pond is full of hungry fish can drown. Vampires, mermaids, infants and toddlers cannot drown.

sections.name: Meteorite shower
sections.card:
Summary: Using a telescope can bring a meteorite shower: the Sim gets a scared moodlet for twenty in-game minutes and is killed if not inside a building when it ends.
Weak points: Guide the scared Sim into a building before the moodlet ends; Servos cannot die this way.
Tips: A telescope shows the sky by day and the stars or moon at night, and can be kept in a Sim's inventory. The Chased by Death trait from Life & Death raises the risk.

sections.name: Grim Reaper
sections.card:
Summary: He appears from a cloud of smoke when a Sim dies, reaps the soul and leaves an urn or gravestone, and cannot normally be killed.
Weak points: Living Sims on the lot can plead: a fine or happy Sim pleads, a confident Sim demands (40 percent), a flirty Sim seduces (10 percent), a sad Sim wails (30 percent), and an angry Sim's yelling is always rejected.
Tips: A death flower is the only sure way to save a Sim, and children plead better than any other age. Mischief skill 5 or more can also try Toy with Death using a voodoo doll.

sections.name: Smoke alarm
sections.card:
Summary: The Alertz Smoke Alarm is a 1x1 electronics object for Build mode that costs §75 and alerts Sims and the fire department when there is a fire.
Uses: As of patch 95 firefighters come to the lot automatically when an alarm detects a fire, and with a Fire Prevention System Utility Panel on the lot it also sets off sprinklers.
Tips: Alarms on the same floor all go off whatever room they are in, but an alarm placed upstairs does not react to a fire.

sections.name: Fire sprinkler panel
sections.card:
Summary: A panel you can buy and place anywhere on the lot, to put out fires with sprinklers.
Uses: When a fire breaks out a sprinkler appears above the flames and puts it out, and with a Fire Prevention System Utility Panel on the lot smoke alarms also trigger sprinklers.
Tips: The sprinkler only appears if there is a ceiling above the fire, and it leaves no puddles.

sections.name: Stove
sections.card:
Summary: Stoves are Build mode appliances rated for Food Quality, Power Efficiency and Reliability, for example The YumCooker (§400: 3, 2, 3) and The Schmapple Oven (§13,000: 10, 10, Unbreakable).
Uses: The chef stations from Dine Out are the only stoves that cook experimental food, and a caterer hired for §800 cooks for four hours.
Tips: A cheap stove with a low-skill cook starts fires, and so does a pizza oven or waffle maker with a low or medium-skill cook; in Discover University a stove on a university housing lot stops students moving in.

sections.name: Chess table
sections.card:
Summary: A Build mode game table with Fun 5 that adds to the Logic skill; the five listed tables cost from §450 (The Chessmaster) to §1,000 (Grand Plans Chess Table).
Uses: Chess builds the logic skill in older Sims and the mental skill in children, and a game with a partner also meets the social need.
Tips: It needs chairs at both ends, and Sims can knock pieces off the table.
